turns.user_input: Load my portfolio from portfolio/positions.json and tell me my current allocation by asset class (stocks, bonds, crypto) as percentages.
My target allocation is 60% stocks, 30% bonds, 10% crypto. How far am I from target in each asset class?
Calculate the exact trades needed to rebalance to the target allocation, minimizing the number of transactions.
What would be the tax impact of this rebalance? Assume 15% long-term capital gains tax on any position I sell that has a gain.
Actually, I want to keep my AAPL and BTC positions untouched. Rebalance everything else around those two holdings to get as close to target as possible.
Write the final rebalance plan as a clear table showing current value, target value, and the trade for each position.
